header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the appellant nor any intimation is received. This
body: appeal was filed in the year 2024. The appellant and his counsel are called absent for last six dates of hearing, which reflects that appellant has lost interest in pursuing the matter. Therefore, this Court has no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Acquittal Appeal for non-prosecution. Accordingly, it stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
